statement:
The record shows the prior court ruling was lifted (suggesting possible restoration) yet a binding order still requires the post stay down.
The post remains taken down per the order in force.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the record's "Court ruling: lifted" as conflicting with the binding order and asserts the correct status: "The post remains taken down per the order in force."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
